deliveryDecision: User approved a separate opt-in package, with possible merging later.

package.name: @breditor/experimental-flat-lists
package.layout: One archive owns dist/browser and dist/wasm; public and advanced exports share the same browser module graph. No default Breditor package dependency or peer engine.

reproducibility: A second assembly at target/flat-list-opt-in-TXcBcO produced the identical archive hash, package tree, raw size and unpacked size.

consumer.node: Public/advanced constructor identity, adjacent binary resolution, actual Wasm initialization and version match, V4 profile factory and blocked private deep imports passed.
consumer.typescript: Strict external compilation passes, including the named flat-list options type and rejection of list options by ordinary open().
consumer.scenario: Profile preflight fingerprint agrees with Rust; custom toolbar uses the public list manifest; heading converts to a bullet list; Undo restores exact document; V6 session restore preserves pending Redo; Redo restores exact converted document; disposal clears host.

scriptTests.skipReason: Existing opt-in browser diagnostic test requires BREDITOR_QUEUE_DIAGNOSTIC_BROWSER=1.

unbuiltPackGuard: Expected failure: direct workspace npm pack --dry-run exits 1 with instructions to use qualified assembly, instead of producing an incomplete archive.
remainingGates: Run the full feature demo suite against this actual opt-in package layout, not only the external consumer scenario.
